newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade active at $68 -feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade active at $68 -feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sold at $68.00 per cwt in brisk activity Wednesday, up $1.00 from sales late last week, feedlot sources said.
However, the $68.00 trade was unchanged from the bulk of last week's sales.
About 70,000 head had sold by late afternoon in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area and about 57,000 in Kansas.
Nebraska cattle feeders also were busy, with about 80,000 sold at $110.00 to $111.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and $68.00 to $68.50 on a live basis, trade sources and USDA said.
